rationale: Both are weak: they mostly define KPIs and option lists without actually comparing alternatives, quantifying tradeoffs, or giving revisit triggers. A at least names a caveat tied to option design, but its recommendation is less actionable and its rationale is more fragmented. B’s recommendation is slightly more decision-useful because “Phased Hybrid” gives a clearer implementation path and directly addresses speed-plus-accuracy via sequencing. Neither provides meaningful quantitative support beyond KPI definitions, and neither handles uncertainty well. B wins narrowly on actionability.
